name: 松本清張スペシャル　山峡の章
original_name: 松本清張スペシャル　山峡の章
overview: Rei Kikukawa, starring in her fourth Seicho Matsumoto drama, delves into the truth behind a mysterious death in order to overcome her grief at the loss of a loved one and clear her name. A profound human drama in the true spirit of Seicho Matsumoto.
